title: About Access Policies Defined by Partners

blocks.text: Access policy rules defined by partners enable you to implement role-based access control and provide access to a partner's applications for Business-to-Business (B2B) Federation. The Defined by Partners page displays the list of policy rules created by the guest partner for the host partner's applications. The Defined by My Tenant page displays the list of policy rules that are defined by the host partner for internal applications and users. Additionally, a guest partner configures the policy rules for all the host partner's applications. To learn more about access policy rules defined by your tenant, see About Access Policies Defined by My Tenant.
Access policies defined by partners provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Gain visibility into how your guest partners have configured access policies on your hosted applications, without managing them directly.
Maintain oversight across all B2B access configurations to ensure partner-defined rules align with your acceptable use and security expectations.

blocks.heading: About the Defined by Partners Page

blocks.text: On the Defined by Partners page (Private Access > Policy > Access Policy > Rules > Defined by Partners), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of policy groups or rules.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Click the Filter icon to show or hide the filters. The number displayed in parentheses next to the icon indicates the number of applied filters.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, the Partner filter is applied to show the most recent federated partner. To learn more, see Using Tables.
View a list of all access policy rules that were defined by partners. For each rule, you can see:
Name: The name of the rule. Click the rule name to open a drawer with additional details (i.e., name, description, rule action, applied criteria).
Rule Action: Indicates the action for the rule (i.e., Allow Access, Block Access, or Require Approval).
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the Defined by My Tenant page to view access policy rules that are created and defined by your tenant.
